predecessors.name: Kahuripan
predecessors.text: 'The Kingdom of Janggala comprised the northeastern part of the Kingdom of Kahuripan'

successors.name: Kediri Kingdom
successors.text: the whole kingdom: Kameswara of Kadiri 'married a princess of the Kingdom of Janggala' in 1136 'at which point the Kingdom of Janggala ceased to exist'

ledger.x: 1045: Janggala is formed in the partition of Kahuripan.
1049: civil war between Janggala and Panjalu after Airlangga's death.
1052: the civil war with Panjalu ends.
1135: Kediri moves on Janggala under Jayabaya.
1136: the fighting ends in a union of the crowns.

wars.name: Janggala-Panjalu civil war
wars.outcome: Fighting between the two halves of Kahuripan after Airlangga's death; the page gives no victor and no change of frontier.

wars.name: Kediri's absorption of Janggala under Jayabaya
wars.outcome: Janggala is taken over by Kediri; the page ends it with the 1136 marriage of Kameswara to a Janggala princess.

certainty.note: The only boundary on the page is the legend of a river made by Mpu Bharada's water; the line between Janggala and Kediri is Cliopatria's.
